The structure of composition Tm16Cu8 (reduced formula Tm2Cu) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imm2 (No. 143). Its unit cell contains 24 atoms distributed over 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Cu centers with 10 Tm neighbors and Tm centers with 12 neighbors (8 Cu, 4 Tm) in close-packed-like local arrangements. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Cu and Tm 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Tm polyhedra.
